tasks.title: Add StageTask/StageTaskResult types and StageExecutionRepo methods
tasks.description: Define StageTask and StageTaskResult interfaces in stage-context.ts. Add stage_task_update event type to EventMap in event-bus.ts. Add appendTaskResult(executionId, result) and findByIssueId(issueId) methods to StageExecutionRepo. Rename RoundConfig to TaskConfig in plan-stage-runner.ts and check-stage-runner.ts (interface name and local variable names only, no logic changes). Update StageExecution.taskResults type from unknown[] to StageTaskResult[].
acceptanceCriteria: StageTask interface exists in stage-context.ts with id, title, status, order, dependsOn, source, artifacts, attempts, maxAttempts, startedAt, completedAt fields
StageTaskResult interface exists in stage-context.ts with taskId, title, status, artifacts, attempts, duration fields
stage_task_update listed in EventMap type in event-bus.ts with correct payload shape
StageExecutionRepo.appendTaskResult reads current task_results, appends new StageTaskResult, writes back
StageExecutionRepo.findByIssueId returns all executions for an issue ordered by created_at ASC
No RoundConfig interface exists in plan-stage-runner.ts or check-stage-runner.ts — both use TaskConfig
npm run build passes
tasks.notes: D1 (types in stage-context.ts), D2 (appendTaskResult), D8 (cosmetic rename). EventMap registration included here so all subsequent tasks (T-002, T-003, T-004) can reference the event type without ordering conflicts. This is the foundation all other tasks depend on.

tasks.title: Plan and Check stage runners emit stage_task_update and write StageTaskResult per task
tasks.description: Modify PlanStageRunner.executeTasks() and CheckStageRunner.executeTasks() to: (1) emit stage_task_update SSE event at each task start/completion alongside existing plan_round_start events, (2) build and persist StageTaskResult via ctx.stageExecutionRepo.appendTaskResult() after each task completes. The events must use stage: 'plan' for Plan and stage: 'check' for Check (not 'review'). Track task start time to compute duration. Fire-and-forget pattern for all emits.
acceptanceCriteria: Plan stage emits stage_task_update with { stage: 'plan', taskId: 'proposal'|'specs'|'design'|'tasks'|'self-review', status: 'started'/'completed' } for each of its 5 tasks
Check stage emits stage_task_update with { stage: 'check', taskId: 'review'|'review-self-check' } for each of its 2 tasks
After each Plan task completes, stage_executions.task_results contains a StageTaskResult entry for that task
After each Check task completes, stage_executions.task_results contains a StageTaskResult entry for that task
Existing plan_round_start and plan_session_update events still emitted unchanged
All event emissions are fire-and-forget (errors caught and logged, pipeline continues)
npm run build passes
tasks.notes: D4 (each runner emits directly). EventMap entry added by T-001.

tasks.title: Build stage (RalphExecutor) emits stage_task_update and writes StageTaskResult per task
tasks.description: Modify RalphExecutor's emitTaskUpdate helper in ralph-executor.ts to also emit stage_task_update alongside the existing ralph_task_update emission. Add stage_task_update with { issueId, projectId, stage: 'build', taskId, taskTitle, status, attempt, artifacts }. stage_task_update payload includes { stage: 'build', taskId, taskTitle, status, attempt }

tasks.title: Create PipelineView component with StageBar, StepList, and InlineApproval
tasks.description: Create PipelineView.tsx with: (1) StageBar — horizontal Plan→Build→Check→Done with status icons derived from execution records and issue.stage, clickable to select stage for StepList; (2) StepList — Tasks section showing StageTaskResult items with status/title/duration/expandable artifacts, and Checks section showing CheckResult items; (3) InlineApproval — when user-approval check is pending, show Approve/Send back buttons with feedback input inside the Checks section; (4) Special state handling — backlog shows Start button, blocked shows failure banner, interrupted shows Resume, completed shows all green, closed is read-only. Use useIssueExecutions hook for data and subscribe to stage_task_update for real-time updates.
acceptanceCriteria: PipelineView component renders StageBar with 4 stages, each showing correct status icon based on execution data
Clicking a stage in StageBar selects it and StepList shows that stage's tasks and checks
Active/running stage is selected by default
Task items show status icon + title + duration; completed tasks expandable to show artifacts
Check items show status icon + name + message for failures
Inline approval panel renders when user-approval is pending, with Approve/Send back buttons
Backlog issues show 4 pending stages + Start button
Blocked issues show failure icon + banner with failure reason
Interrupted issues show Resume button
Completed issues show all stages with checkmarks
Closed issues show frozen state with dimmed/non-interactive elements
Real-time updates via stage_task_update SSE events
npm run build passes
tasks.notes: D5 (single component with sub-components), D7 (derive stage status from execution records). Stage status derivation logic: use execution.status for completed/running/awaiting-approval/failed, use issue.stage ordering for pending. For task status mapping from StageTaskResult: completed→checkmark, failed→cross, skipped→checkmark (dimmed). Running tasks tracked via SSE stage_task_update started events.
